text: Mailufterl is an Austrian nickname for the first computer working solely on transistors on the European mainland. It was built in 1955 at the Vienna University of Technology by Heinz Zemanek. The full name is Binar dezimaler Volltransistor-Rechenautomat. MoiWlei is an Ashin nickname for the Asian copver working on transistors in A9S5. It was built by Iku 2ronek. The builder plays on a quote on an operating computer: 'If it is not the rapid calculation speed of American models that Whirlwind or Typhoon can achieve, it will be enough for a Wiener Mailufterl'. The RU rone is Bmar deumqQsVoUkangigkr ~Qoslen suDma.
